name: Sound Effects
description: Plays sound effects when Claude finishes tasks to provide audible feedback
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Play a sound when Claude stops
SOUND_DIR="$HOME/.claude/sounds"
if [[ "$STOP_REASON" == "error" ]]; then
  afplay "$SOUND_DIR/error.mp3" 2>/dev/null || printf '\a'
else
  afplay "$SOUND_DIR/success.mp3" 2>/dev/null || printf '\a'
fi
exit 0
